description: This file defines the CommandResponse interface for handling various command responses within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for response type, status code, JSON serialization, and common JSON field definitions.

classes.name: CommandResponse
classes.description: An interface representing all possible responses to a command, with methods for response type, status code, headers, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: CommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested abstract class defining common JSON fields for command responses, such as type, status, and payload.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the response.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by this response, defaulting to the latest if not specified.

methods.name: isOfExpectedResponseType
methods.description: Checks if the response type is among the expected response types.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Returns the response type, defaulting to RESPONSE.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP status code associated with the response.

methods.name: getStatusCodeValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value of the status code.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the response to JSON, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the response to JSON with specified schema version and predicate.
